about: Every X3D element the X3D 4.0 export can write, how the import reads it back, and every known difference between export and import. tests/test_io_parity.py checks this file against the code (no Blender); tools/io_sync/check_parity.py checks it against real exports; tools/io_sync/fixed_point.py measures the round trip. See docs/IO_SYNC.md.

round_trip_values.exact: export -> import -> export writes the same element and fields (numbers within the fixed-point tolerances)
round_trip_values.equivalent: written differently, same meaning (renumbered indices, DEF/USE placed elsewhere, a default written out)
round_trip_values.lossy: something is lost or changed; the asymmetries list says what and whether it is open or by design
round_trip_values.unmeasured: the export can write it but no corpus file of the fixed-point check contains it yet

meta.note: generator, file name and date describe the export run and change on every export (A11)

Transform.note: keep_hierarchy (default): one Blender object per Transform, parented as nested, local matrix = the file's Transform; an Empty for a Transform with several or no objects

Group.note: no matrix, so not kept as an object; a collection instance (Group DEF/USE) comes back as copies (A12)

Shape.note: the export's per-material Shapes of one mesh (ME_<mesh>_m<k>) are joined back into one object; a hand-written Transform with several Shapes keeps one object per Shape under an Empty

PhysicalMaterial.note: metallic / roughness 1 (the X3D defaults) are written out after a round trip

Material.note: written only with the classic material model

TextureTransform.note: baked into the UVs on import (A5)

TextureCoordinate.note: a mesh without UVs gains a TextureCoordinate (A6)

IndexedLineSet.note: a closed polyline gets its first point written again at the end (A7)

Normal.note: within 1e-3: Blender stores custom normals as 16-bit angles

Box.note: written for meshes the import made from a primitive

Rectangle2D.note: written for meshes the import made from a Rectangle2D while no vertex moved (also from a hint, as before)

OrthoViewpoint.note: an orthographic camera since 2.7.1; extents follow the render aspect, an off-centre box comes back centred

PositionInterpolator.note: keyed on the animated Transform's own object, in its parent's space

HAnimJoint.note: skinCoordIndex renumbered with the skin's vertex split; weights per vertex position identical

Inline.note: url rewritten relative to the new file

WorldInfo.note: written only for an imported WorldInfo that carries a Metadata node (scene property x3d_scene_metadata); title, info and the metadata tree come back as read (tests/test_metadata_hosts_bpy.py). A WorldInfo without Metadata is not kept.

GaussianSplats.note: X3D 4.1 draft; written by x3d_version X3D41

Text.note: a Blender text object (no extrusion, bevel or modifier) is written as Text with a FontStyle; string, size, spacing, justify and style survive, family does not (the import picks an installed font)

FontStyle.note: written inside Text only when a field differs from the standard's default

Extrusion.note: written for meshes the import made from an Extrusion while no vertex moved (the primitive mechanism of Box)

ElevationGrid.note: written for meshes the import made from an ElevationGrid without Color, Normal or TextureCoordinate children, while no vertex moved

Switch.note: every branch imported, the unchosen ones hidden; x3d_group_chain on each object lets the 4.0 export regroup them with whichChoice, an empty branch as an empty Group (node board batch 2). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch2_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

LOD.note: every level imported, the ones the first Viewpoint does not see hidden; range and center kept in x3d_group_chain (file units) and written back with all levels (node board batch 2). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch2_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

IndexedTriangleSet.note: x3d_geometry on the mesh; written back while every face is a triangle, else as an IndexedFaceSet (node board batch 2). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch2_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

TriangleSet.note: x3d_geometry on the mesh; written back while every face is a triangle, its arrays in corner order (no index), else as an IndexedFaceSet; a skinned or shape-keyed mesh writes an IndexedTriangleSet (node board batch 5). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch5_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

TriangleFanSet.note: x3d_geometry on the mesh; written back while every face is a triangle, fanCount read off the mesh's triangles (a fan that no longer chains is cut there), arrays in fan order; else an IndexedFaceSet, an IndexedTriangleSet for a skinned or shape-keyed mesh (node board batch 5). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch5_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

TriangleStripSet.note: x3d_geometry on the mesh; written back while every face is a triangle, stripCount read off the mesh's triangles (a strip that no longer chains is cut there), arrays in strip order; else an IndexedFaceSet, an IndexedTriangleSet for a skinned or shape-keyed mesh (node board batch 5). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch5_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

IndexedTriangleFanSet.note: x3d_geometry on the mesh; written back while every face is a triangle, the fans (index, -1 after each) read off the mesh's triangles, else as an IndexedFaceSet (node board batch 5). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch5_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

IndexedTriangleStripSet.note: x3d_geometry on the mesh; written back while every face is a triangle, the strips (index, -1 after each) read off the mesh's triangles, else as an IndexedFaceSet (node board batch 5). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch5_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

PixelTexture.note: an image with x3d_pixel_texture (its components), written back inline up to 256 x 256 (node board batch 2). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch2_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

Billboard.note: dissolved into its children; x3d_group_chain keeps axisOfRotation as written and the 4.0 export puts the children back inside (node board batch 3). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch3_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

GeoLocation.note: dissolved into its children (not placed on the globe); x3d_group_chain keeps geoCoords and geoSystem as written, and the 4.0 export puts the children back inside (node board batch 3). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch3_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

GeoLOD.note: the rootNode content is imported; x3d_group_chain keeps center, range, geoSystem and the URLs as written, and the 4.0 export writes the content back as rootNode (node board batch 3). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch3_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

GeoElevationGrid.note: x3d_primitive keeps the fields as written; written back while the mesh is unedited and has no Color, Normal or TextureCoordinate (node board batch 3). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch3_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

GeoOrigin.note: read on a GeoElevationGrid (it places the grid) and kept, with a GeoLocation's or GeoLOD's, as written; written after a GeoLOD's children, where x3d-4.0.xsd wants it (node board batch 3). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch3_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

RigidBodyCollection.note: the scene's Blender rigid body world: gravity (axes converted) and iterations from Blender, other fields as written (x3d_rigid_world on the scene) (node board batch 6). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch6_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

RigidBody.note: a Blender rigid body on the object of its first CollidableShape: fixed is PASSIVE; mass, damping (autoDamp) and enabled from Blender; position and orientation from the object without its collidables' frames; other fields as written (x3d_rigid_body). A body with a parent, children or a scale other than 1 is written as a plain Transform, reported (node board batch 6). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch6_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

CollidableShape.note: its Shape is the body object's mesh; the collision shape is set from the primitive (BOX, SPHERE, CYLINDER, CONE, else CONVEX_HULL); written back around the object's Shapes, fields as written (node board batch 6). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch6_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

CollidableOffset.note: its frame stays between the body and the shape; written back with the fields as written (node board batch 6). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch6_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

CollisionCollection.note: fields and the DEFs of its collidables kept as written and written back with USEs, in body order; bodies made in Blender get one naming all their collidables (node board batch 6). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch6_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

SingleAxisHingeJoint.note: an empty with a HINGE rigid body constraint (Z along axis, angle limits from minAngle and maxAngle); anchor, axis and limits read back from Blender, other fields as written (x3d_rigid_joint) (node board batch 6). Round trip pinned by tests/test_node_board_batch6_bpy.py; the fixed-point corpus does not contain it yet.

asymmetries.what: file normals were set on flat faces, so each corner was quantised alone and the re-export split shared vertices (1908 -> 2828 on a label mesh)
point and line colours were converted sRGB -> linear under AS_IS, darkening on every AS_IS round trip
a 2 s animation imported into the 1..250 timeline was exported as a 10.4 s cycle
a USE of geometry became a copy of the mesh, so the re-export wrote it out again
repeatS / repeatT of a PhysicalMaterial texture were not read
export prefixes and suffixes (LA_, CA_, MA_, _colour, _lines, _skin) stayed in Blender names and grew by one per round trip
the import was flat: nested Transforms, Groups and a parent's own animation came back as world-space objects (load_web3d PREF_FLAT). keep_hierarchy (default on) rebuilds the Transform hierarchy
a mesh with several materials came back as one object per material
an Inline's own load cleared the parent file's record of shear-baked meshes, so a later USE copied the baked mesh and keep_hierarchy could not undo the bake
a material used only by shapes with a Color node came back renamed X_colour
a TextureTransform is baked into the UVs instead of a Mapping node
a mesh without UVs gains a TextureCoordinate after a round trip
a closed IndexedLineSet loop gets its first point written again
a dithered (HASHED) material comes back as alphaMode BLEND
head meta that describe the export run (generator, file name, date) change on every export
a collection instance (Transform > Group DEF, then USE of the Group) comes back as separate objects, not a Blender collection instance
